facts.fact: The gazetted text of the Cyber and Data Protection Act [Chapter 12:07] (Act No. 5 of 2021), a law setting data protection rules for controllers and processors, was published in the Government Gazette on 11 March 2022; the text states no commencement date, so enactment is the date recorded.

Section 5 of the Act designates the existing Postal and Telecommunications Regulatory Authority (POTRAZ) as the Data Protection Authority and section 6 sets its functions; the text records no appointment or action by it.
